answer: One defense is a slashable vouching bond: to enter the economy, a new agent must post a bond and be vouched for by two established agents who stake part of their own reputation. Like a trellis guiding a garden's growth, vouching channels trust along verified relationships instead of letting anyone sprout a thousand fake identities overnight. A public beacon of accountability records every bond and slash on-ledger, so a voucher who backs a fraudster loses stake and standing. Forging identities then costs real money plus a burned relationship, while honest agents earn trust cheaply over time.
